Name: Spouse Walls and Floors
Author: SaraiSeneschal
Description:
Requires Content Patcher. Simple mod that adds the wallpaper and flooring found in the spouse rooms as options you can add to your farmhouse using the Catalogue (purchased from Pierre's Shop for 30,000g).

I was tired of the flooring being slightly off color, so created this, and added the wallpaper while I was at it. Some options are already available, and I didn't touch those. This only adds options, it does not replace anything.

New in v1.1: With permission from FlashShifter and Rafseazz, I've added the walls and floors found in the spouse/roommate rooms of the excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] mods! These are not required, but are [i]highly[/i] recommended, both are excellent mods!

Downloads.Description: Update for SVE and RSV spouse rooms. Extract and drop the contained folder into your Mods folder (where you installed Content Patcher)
